parameters.jsCode: const propertyId='YOUR_PROPERTY_ID';if(!/^\d+$/.test(propertyId))throw Error('Configure a Google Analytics property ID');const day=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),d=n=>new Date(Date.parse(day+'T00:00:00Z')+n*86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10);return [{json:{propertyId,day,recentStart:d(-7),recentEnd:d(-1),previousStart:d(-14),previousEnd:d(-8)}}];

pagination.completeExpression: ={{ (() => { const b=$response.body;if(!b||typeof b!=='object')throw Error('Invalid analytics page');const rows=b.rows??[],count=b.rowCount??0;if(!Array.isArray(rows)||!Number.isSafeInteger(count)||count<0||rows.length>10000||(!Number.isSafeInteger($pageCount))||$pageCount<1)throw Error('Invalid analytics page count');const consumed=($pageCount-1)*10000+rows.length;if(consumed>count||(consumed<count&&rows.length!==10000))throw Error('Incomplete analytics page');return consumed===count; })() }}
